title: [RUST-R3H] 线索管理与评分十四操作
body:
父任务：#85；总体#57。状态：Todo / G1准备。

用户已授权R3剩余28操作完整G0–G4；来源main 7f970c992291c61477eb9bd83a48cec19a769d88。本片14操作，作者A。

- POST `/api/lead-score-overrides/{id}:approve` — `LeadScoreOverrideController_approve`
- POST `/api/lead-score-overrides/{id}:reject` — `LeadScoreOverrideController_reject`
- POST `/api/lead-score-overrides/{id}:revoke` — `LeadScoreOverrideController_revoke`
- GET `/api/leads` — `LeadController_list`
- POST `/api/leads` — `LeadController_create`
- GET `/api/leads/{id}` — `LeadController_getById`
- PATCH `/api/leads/{id}` — `LeadController_update`
- POST `/api/leads/{id}:assignOwner` — `LeadController_assignOwner`
- POST `/api/leads/{id}:claim` — `LeadController_claimOwner`
- POST `/api/leads/{id}:close` — `LeadController_close`
- POST `/api/leads/{id}:convertToProject` — `LeadController_convertToProject`
- POST `/api/leads/{id}:qualify` — `LeadController_qualify`
- GET `/api/leads/{id}/score-history` — `LeadController_getScoreHistory`
- POST `/api/leads/{id}/score-overrides` — `LeadController_submitScoreOverride`

线索九项基础/归属/资格/关闭/转换，评分历史及人工覆盖提交/批准/驳回/撤销五项；必须包含系统评分v2事实、同事务转换项目/附件复制/评分快照及原编号/审计/会话边界。

类型cross-layer-high-risk。原Native controller/spec/canonical已逐项aligned；仅迁移现有公开契约，不新增Native/DTO/client/DDL语义。联合G1须冻结精确来源、错误优先序、Unicode/money/date/编号/事务/审计/会话/权限/共享接口；非作者独立Pass前不进入Rust实现。

- [x] G0：原生父子Issue、28项互斥归属与依赖登记
- [ ] G1：联合输入/原Native见证/来源哈希与独立冻结
- [ ] 本片全部操作及必要内部写链实现
- [ ] 双端真实HTTP/PG、原UI、故障并发和全部owned终态
- [ ] 独立G3、固定提交复核、main集成与集成后核验
- [ ] G4：独立关闭许可、原字节归档/保全及线上本地状态一致

三实现线：H14、I10、J2+K2；Root独占公共HTTP/路由/Cargo/lib/共享桥及所有实际环境/构建测试DBHTTPbrowser/fixture/cleanup/正式治理，作者仅其独占模块与定义。Gate独审占空闲席位；子代理明确gpt-6.1-sol/max，Fast未核实。

正式交付仍30/58，本片实际G4后才加计数，四片完成可58/58公共操作；R3完整非HTTP/审批/阶段验收另片，本批只收口自己的四子项，父#85/#57保持Open。上批5机器输入E1须本次G1复核，不继承批准；旧private/PG17/历史失败partial/stopped/uncertified/quarantine/54ignored不改，只用本轮新隔离namespace，无部署/切流/真实性能结论。
